title: lepidium montanum subsp. cinereum
intro: Lepidium montanum subsp. cinereum, commonly known as Mountain Pepper, is a perennial plant species in the Brassicaceae family. It is native to the mountainous regions of Western Australia and is traditionally used by the Indigenous Australians for its medicinal and culinary purposes. The health benefits of Mountain Pepper include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in wound healing and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include isothiocyanates, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antiviral, and anticancer properties.
